summary.headline: IKIO Q2 FY27 revenue rose 27% YoY to INR209 crores and EBITDA margin expanded 220 bps to 13.4%.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue from operations grew 27% YoY and 23% QoQ to INR209 crores, with H1 revenue up 33% to INR378 crores. EBITDA rose 52% YoY to INR28 crores at a 13.4% margin, stable QoQ, and H1 EBITDA grew 71% to INR51 crores. PAT grew 18% YoY to INR13 crores in Q2 and 80% to INR24 crores in H1. Management said non-lighting ("other") businesses grew 47% YoY to INR289 crores in H1, and Block 2 was partially commercialised in Q2.

financial_highlights.change: +52% YoY, +22% QoQ; margin +220 bps YoY from 11.2%

financial_highlights.value: INR67 crores (per analyst's figure, confirmed by management in part)
About INR187 crores (approx.), 50% of revenue mix

segments.name: Lighting (incl. automotive, in-store, refrigeration, Middle East export)
segments.commentary: Management put lighting at about 75% of revenue; conventional ODM home lighting is about INR45 crores. Of the roughly INR162 crores subsidiary revenue, 55-60% was in-store/refrigeration lighting and 10-12% Middle East lighting.

segments.name: Other businesses (hearables/wearables, EMS, automotive lighting, solar, electronics, US)
segments.commentary: About 25% of revenue; grew 47% YoY to INR289 crores in H1. Hearables/wearables from Block 2 contributed about INR20-22 crores in Q2.

segments.name: Automotive lighting
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue about INR5 crores, the first quarter of supply, aftermarket only; OEM window opened. Customers named include Bosch, Motherson, Sumi and Minda.

segments.name: Middle East (Royalux FZCO)
segments.commentary: Management cited about 70-80% QoQ growth from Q1 to Q2 FY27 and a new fit-out and installation project in Dubai.

guidance_outlook: Other (non-lighting) business growth expected at 35% to 45-50% for FY27 on YoY basis, versus earlier 30% guidance.
Consolidated EBITDA margin: 13-14% guided for FY27, in line with Q2 performance.
Steady-state consolidated EBITDA margin of 16% to 18%, about 1.5 years out, once new verticals and plants are fully commercialised.
Block 2 (about 2 lakh sq ft) fully commercialised by Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28; 70-75% utilisation to take longer. Full-utilisation revenue estimated at INR150-200 crores a year.
Block 3 construction to finish by Q3 FY27 at more than 1 lakh sq ft, above the earlier plan after Noida Authority norm changes.
Incremental annual depreciation after full capex estimated at about INR15-20 crores; management will confirm later. Q2 depreciation was INR7.5 crores.
EV chargers for major customers expected to show results in one to two quarters after trial runs.
capex_capacity: Block 1 (about 2 lakh sq ft) is fully operational at the Noida greenfield site.
Block 2 (about 2 lakh sq ft) partially commercialised in Q2 FY27; utilisation is partial because orders are shifting from the previous location.
Block 3 construction is on track; more than 1 lakh sq ft expected, about 3 lakh sq ft total across the new blocks.
Over 3,000 SKUs managed with a 50+ member R&D team; in-house design, tooling, component manufacturing, assembly and testing.
New EMS facility: about 20-25% of output used for captive consumption, the rest for external customers.
demand_pricing: Lighting demand is widening beyond one large ODM home-lighting customer, which has since formed a JV; new home-lighting customers were added and product ranges expanded with them.
Institutional, hotel and IT projects are growing in B2B; management said it will not enter B2C.
Automotive aftermarket: Tier-1 customers are over-ordering versus forecast as the market shifts from conventional to LED, with 4-month plans picked up in one month.
Honeywell: commercial production started a couple of quarters back; a strategic product pipeline exists under NDA, with non-India markets being explored.
Working capital for non-lighting (ODM) businesses is 75-90 days.

qa_highlights.question: How much revenue did Block 2 contribute in Q2, and what is its full-run potential?
qa_highlights.answer: Block 2 contributed about INR20-22 crores in Q2, mainly hearables and wearables. Full-space utilisation could yield about INR150-200 crores a year, with timing dependent on customer onboarding.

qa_highlights.question: Is it fair to assume FY27 sales of about INR750 crores at a 14% EBITDA margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said prior guidance was conservative because of geopolitical and duty volatility. It expects growth to be better than planned but did not give a revised full-year figure.

qa_highlights.question: Can the subsidiary margin reach 18%, and what is the steady-state consolidated margin?
qa_highlights.answer: Management guided a steady-state consolidated EBITDA margin of 16-18% in about 1.5 years, once new verticals reach efficiencies and capex is absorbed.

qa_highlights.question: Has the standalone entity's ODM lighting revenue been affected by the transition?
qa_highlights.answer: Of standalone Q2 revenue, about INR44-45 crores was ODM lighting and about INR22 crores hearables/wearables. The subsidiary-to-standalone transfer completes from December, so Q4 will be the clear read.

qa_highlights.question: Will the non-lighting (other) business guidance be raised from 30%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects other-business growth of 35% to 45-50% YoY for FY27, citing seasonality and geopolitical risk.

qa_highlights.question: What is the depreciation outlook after capex?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said incremental depreciation is about INR15-20 crores a year, but it would confirm the figure later. The analyst's figure implied about INR18-20 crores added to last year's INR30-odd crores.

risks_watch: Block 2 utilisation: needs to reach 70-75% and the full-revenue run-rate depends on shifting orders from the previous location.
Geopolitical risk from Gulf tensions and duty and policy changes, which management cited for conservative guidance.
Concentration: lighting still about 75% of revenue; management says it is diversifying toward smaller anchor customers.
Subsidiary-to-standalone transfer of hearables/wearables business completes from December; Q4 FY27 is the first clean read.
Depreciation guidance is pending from management; incremental INR15-20 crores a year was indicated.
Automotive lighting: Tier-1 over-ordering could reverse as the LED transition matures.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth and diversification, with the Q2 numbers presented as beating earlier plans. Cautious on near-term timing and geopolitics: management declined to give a revised FY27 sales figure or Block 2 timelines, and deferred depreciation guidance.
key_quotes: by the end of this year, we truly believe that the growth is going to be much better than what we had planned or anticipated in the beginning of the year.
once that subsides, then it is, as per our understanding, it should be somewhere on a console level, should be somewhere between 16% to 18%.
we will never go into B2C.
Our intention is to continue to diversify and probably have smaller sets of anchor customers instead of having on bigger customer with a bigger chunk of revenue share.

adds.what: Block 2 (about 2 lakh sq ft) at Noida, partially commercialised in Q2 FY27, full commercialisation by Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28
Block 3 (more than 1 lakh sq ft) at Noida, construction to finish by Q3 FY27

growth.why: Management raised FY27 non-lighting growth guidance to 35-45/50% YoY (from 30%) and guided a 13-14% FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin, backed by Block 2 partial commercialisation, Block 3 due by Q3 FY27, automotive OEM window and Honeywell pipeline, though no firm total revenue growth number was given.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.when: next 2-4 quarters; steady state in ~1.5 years
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin 13.4% (up 220 bps YoY from 11.2%), FY27 consolidated margin guided at 13-14%, and steady-state 16-18% expected in about 1.5 years once new verticals and plants are commercialised.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Block 1 (about 2 lakh sq ft) is fully operational and Block 2 (about 2 lakh sq ft) is partially commercialised, with full commercialisation by Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28; Block 3 (more than 1 lakh sq ft) construction finishes by Q3 FY27.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 FY27 revenue rose 33% YoY to INR378 crores and non-lighting business grew 47% YoY to INR289 crores, with FY27 other-business growth guided at 35-45/50% (up from 30%).

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No new capex beyond Blocks 2 and 3 was discussed; current Block 2 is still ramping to 70-75% utilisation, so a fresh capex announcement in the window is not signalled.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management called prior guidance conservative and raised other-business growth to 35-45/50% from 30%, but gave no revised total FY27 revenue figure and declined to update Block 2 timelines.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Block 2 utilisation depends on shifting orders from the old location, Gulf tensions and duty changes are flagged, and automotive Tier-1 over-ordering could reverse as the LED transition matures.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Hearables/wearables from Block 2 contributed about INR20-22 crores in Q2, automotive OEM window opened after INR5 crores aftermarket quarter, and a Honeywell strategic product pipeline is under NDA with non-India markets being explored.

rows.label: Automotive OEM window and Tier-1 over-ordering
rows.why: Automotive lighting revenue was about INR5 crores in Q2 (first supply quarter, aftermarket only), Tier-1 customers (Bosch, Motherson, Sumi, Minda) are over-ordering versus forecast, and 4-month plans were picked up in one month.

rows.label: Middle East (Royalux FZCO) growth
rows.why: Middle East grew about 70-80% QoQ from Q1 to Q2 FY27 and a new Dubai fit-out and installation project was added, with Middle East lighting at 10-12% of subsidiary revenue.

rows.label: Depreciation step-up after Block 2 and 3
rows.why: Incremental annual depreciation of about INR15-20 crores is indicated on top of Q2 depreciation of INR7.5 crores, which weighs on PAT even as EBITDA grows.

tone.note: Management was confident on non-lighting diversification, raised other-business growth guidance and called prior guidance conservative, but was cautious on Block 2 timing, geopolitics and depreciation; analysts pressed on the FY27 revenue figure, margin path to 18%, and depreciation.
